chinese: 尊敬的各位领导、各位来宾：大家好！
pinyin: Zūnjìng de gèwèi lǐngdǎo, gèwèi láibīn: dàjiā hǎo!
english: Respected leaders, distinguished guests: hello, everyone!

chinese: 我叫张居信，是张学良将军的孙子。
pinyin: Wǒ jiào Zhāng Jūxìn, shì Zhāng Xuéliáng jiāngjūn de sūnzi.
english: My name is Zhang Juxin. I am General Zhang Xueliang's grandson.

chinese: 感谢主办方邀请我来到北京。
pinyin: Gǎnxiè zhǔbànfāng yāoqǐng wǒ láidào Běijīng.
english: Thank you to the hosts for inviting me to Beijing.

chinese: 九十年前，我的祖父和杨虎城将军，为了停止内战、一致抗日，发动了西安事变。
pinyin: Jiǔshí nián qián, wǒ de zǔfù hé Yáng Hǔchéng jiāngjūn, wèile tíngzhǐ nèizhàn, yízhì kàngrì, fādòng le Xī'ān Shìbiàn.
english: Ninety years ago, my grandfather and General Yang Hucheng launched the Xi'an Incident in order to stop the civil war and unite in resisting Japan.

chinese: 此后，他失去自由五十多年。
pinyin: Cǐhòu, tā shīqù zìyóu wǔshí duō nián.
english: After that, he lost his freedom for more than fifty years.

chinese: 我的祖母赵一荻，一直陪在他身边。
pinyin: Wǒ de zǔmǔ Zhào Yīdí, yìzhí péi zài tā shēnbiān.
english: My grandmother Zhao Yidi stayed by his side all along.

chinese: 我从一岁起，每年都去台湾看望祖父。
pinyin: Wǒ cóng yí suì qǐ, měinián dōu qù Táiwān kànwàng zǔfù.
english: Starting from the age of one, I went to Taiwan every year to visit my grandfather.

pinyin: Tā gěi wǒ jiǎng le hěn duō gùshi.

chinese: 从这些故事里，我感受到他深爱中国，深爱中国人民。
pinyin: Cóng zhèxiē gùshi lǐ, wǒ gǎnshòu dào tā shēn'ài Zhōngguó, shēn'ài Zhōngguó rénmín.
english: From these stories, I felt that he deeply loved China and deeply loved the Chinese people.

chinese: 看到同胞受苦，他很心痛。
pinyin: Kàndào tóngbāo shòukǔ, tā hěn xīntòng.
english: Seeing his compatriots suffer, he was deeply pained.

chinese: 他心里想的，不是自己，而是同胞。
pinyin: Tā xīnlǐ xiǎng de, búshì zìjǐ, érshì tóngbāo.
english: What was in his heart was not himself, but his compatriots.

chinese: 祖父做人的原则是："不怕死，不爱钱。"
pinyin: Zǔfù zuòrén de yuánzé shì: "Bú pà sǐ, bú ài qián."
english: My grandfather's principles were: "Not afraid of death, not loving money."

chinese: 我会把这段历史，告诉下一代。
pinyin: Wǒ huì bǎ zhè duàn lìshǐ, gàosu xià yí dài.
english: I will tell this history to the next generation.

chinese: 愿中华民族团结、和平、繁荣！谢谢大家！
pinyin: Yuàn Zhōnghuá mínzú tuánjié, hépíng, fánróng! Xièxie dàjiā!
english: May the Chinese nation be united, peaceful, and prosperous! Thank you all!
